name: talos-desktop
description: Talos desktop shell for the shared WebUI and local app-server runtime.
author: Talos

scripts.build: TALOS_WEB_BASE=./ VITE_TALOS_DESKTOP=1 pnpm --filter talos-web build && pnpm build:main
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build && TALOS_DESKTOP_APP_SERVER_PROFILE=release pnpm prepare:app-server && TALOS_DESKTOP_PACKAGE_TARGET=desktop-mac electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build && TALOS_DESKTOP_APP_SERVER_PROFILE=release pnpm prepare:app-server && TALOS_DESKTOP_PACKAGE_TARGET=desktop-linux electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.smoke: pnpm build && (cd ../../talos-rs && cargo build -p app-server --bin app-server) && node scripts/desktop-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
